_comment: Harness allowlist (see harness/settings.example.json for the annotated original). In headless (-p) runs, acceptEdits auto-approves file edits but NOT bash commands — without this allowlist the generator stalls on its first build or test command. One merged allowlist covers both stacks. 'cat' is deliberately absent (defeats the .env read deny); curl is pinned to localhost with the port colon. Hooks: kill-switch.sh halts ALL tool calls the moment harness/STOP exists (immediate stop, not just between rounds); steer.sh delivers a one-time operator note from harness/STEER.md to the running agent. The evaluator's evidence-gate hooks live in harness/eval-settings.json.
